sections.executive_summary: Russian forces destroyed over 80 gas stations in Kharkiv Oblast, leaving the Kharkiv–Poltava route without fuel infrastructure. Ukrainian defense forces struck the 'Priority' oil depot in Udmurtia and damaged Russian drone storage facilities in occupied Crimea and Luhansk Oblast. Zelenskyy met with Trump in Washington to discuss Patriot missile production licenses and diplomatic efforts.
ukraine: Russian forces destroyed over 80 gas stations in Kharkiv Oblast, leaving the Kharkiv–Poltava route without fuel infrastructure. A Kharkiv regional council deputy reported the situation worsening daily (Source: @UkraineNow/82977).

Ukrainian defense forces struck the 'Priority' oil depot in Udmurtia, a strategic facility for long-term fuel storage. Attacks also targeted Russian drone storage facilities in occupied Crimea and Luhansk Oblast (Source: @UkraineNow/82973).

Zelenskyy met with Trump in Washington, discussing Patriot missile production licenses and diplomatic activation. The meeting emphasized defense cooperation and avoiding escalation (Source: @UkraineNow/82986).
A Ukrainian military intelligence officer was assassinated in Odesa via car bomb. The victim sustained minor injuries after an explosive device detonated under his BMW X5 (Source: @eRadarrua/102991).

The Southern Mining and Processing Plant partially suspended operations due to Russian attacks on ships and ports. At least 12 vessels were hit by Russian missile strikes in July (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31993).

Russian officials denied any need for mobilization, claiming rumors are part of enemy propaganda ahead of elections (Source: @tass_agency/387583).
Russian investigators opened a terrorism case following a Ukrainian strike on a passenger bus in Belgorod Oblast (Source: @tass_agency/387577).

sections.threat_assessment: Russian forces are intensifying attacks on critical infrastructure, including fuel depots and transportation hubs, to disrupt Ukrainian logistics. The destruction of over 80 gas stations in Kharkiv Oblast signals a broader campaign against supply lines. Iranian involvement remains a concern, with potential ballistic missile strikes threatened. Russian tactical aviation is increasing activity on multiple fronts, particularly the northeastern axis. Ukrainian drone operations continue to target Russian naval assets in the Sea of Azov.
sections.regional_response: Zelenskyy's meeting with Trump focused on defense cooperation, including Patriot missile production licenses. The EU is preparing a major sanctions package targeting over 1,600 companies supporting Russia. Ukraine's Foreign Minister reached out to Iran to de-escalate tensions following recent maritime incidents. Diplomatic efforts are ongoing to prevent further escalation, particularly regarding Iranian involvement. Regional actors are closely monitoring the situation as both sides continue military operations.
sections.intelligence_notes: Russian recruitment efforts have intensified, with over 200,000 contract soldiers joining the military in the first half of the year. Ukrainian partisan activity is evident in Odesa, where a military officer was targeted. The Southern Mining and Processing Plant suspension highlights the impact of Russian attacks on Ukraine's industrial capacity. Drone warfare remains a key component of both sides' strategies, with frequent cross-border operations. Information warfare is active, with disinformation campaigns targeting both domestic and international audiences.
